Raffles London at The OWO has appointed Yazid Ichemrahen as Head Pâtissier. The appointment was reported on 17 November 2026 by Hospitality & Catering News.

## From Paris to Whitehall

Ichemrahen joins from Le Royal Monceau – Raffles Paris, where he moved in April 2024 to lead the pastry and dessert offering. The transfer keeps him inside the Raffles family, moving between the brand's two European flagships: the Paris palace on avenue Hoche and the former Old War Office in Whitehall, which opened as Raffles London at The OWO.

In London, his remit covers desserts across the hotel, guest amenities and seasonal culinary experiences.

## A first collaboration with Christofle

One of his first projects is a festive collection created with Christofle, the French silversmith. It reaches guests at several points of their stay, from welcome treats to in-room dining, with a signature creation served in the hotel's Heritage Suites.

## A career already on screen

Born in Épernay in 1991, Ichemrahen trained alongside Pascal Caffet, Angelo Musa, Philippe Conticini and Joël Robuchon. He won the World Frozen Dessert Championship in Rimini at the age of 22. He has written two books, and his life inspired the 2023 film À la belle étoile, directed by Sébastien Tulard.

He also runs his own projects. In 2025 he opened At Home, a 100 m² culinary space in Paris with a boutique and private dining room. His Ycone pastry concept is present at Lys Martagon in Courchevel and at Raffles Al Areen Palace in Bahrain.

## The signal

Raffles is using its own pipeline to staff its most visible hotels, and it is putting a pastry chef with a public profile at the front of the London offer. For luxury hotels, the pâtissier has become a name that guests know, follow and travel for, much like the head chef.

Congratulations to Yazid Ichemrahen on his new role.

summary: The French pastry chef, world frozen dessert champion at 22, moves from Le Royal Monceau – Raffles Paris to Raffles London at The OWO, starting with a Christofle collaboration.
title: Yazid Ichemrahen becomes Head Pâtissier of Raffles London at The OWO
why: A pastry chef with a public profile moves between Raffles' two European flagships.
